clips.title: The story
paras: Havoc in the Highlands is a preemptive strike undertaken on behalf of Shen'dar Village to disrupt an impending assault by Al'Aketh zealots. By striking their vanguard at the ruins of Falaath Village and eliminating Commander Cyclas, defenders turn the tables on the cultists before they can overrun the highlands.

Facing an imminent invasion from zealous cultists, the leadership of Shen'dar Village decides that a swift preemptive offensive offers the best chance of survival. Rather than awaiting an attack behind fragile defenses, an adventurer is dispatched into the ruins of Falaath Village to catch the hostile Al'Aketh forces off guard before their assault can launch.

The staging grounds at Falaath Village crawl with dangerous zealots wielding chaotic elemental power. Striking at the gathering forces requires dispatching Al'Aketh Stormcallers, shattering conjured Living Lightning, and tracking down Commander Cyclas himself to behead the expedition's leadership.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... Just in case you don't return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.
You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.
